primary_metric: Mean per-user fraction of scheduled visits with a simulated click; intention-to-treat
uncertainty: Resample simulated users within arm, preserving all visits. Conditional on this invented world only.
analysis: Fixed 3000-user horizon, no early stopping, no tuning after evaluation, SRM at user level, missing feedback never imputed as no-click
response_source: Seeded probabilistic behavioral simulator; zero LLM respondent calls; no human traffic
comparison: New synthetic-world models: historical popularity versus contextual LightGBM, not the FairJob/EB-NeRD trained artifacts
limitations: Preferences, examination, attrition and click probabilities are invented and not calibrated to people.
Training and evaluation share the simulator, so model compatibility can produce an apparent lift by construction.
Three experiments reuse the same 3000 personas; they are not 9000 independent users.
Simulated cold ads are new IDs from the same invented feature distribution, not real first-exposure evidence.
No bids, payment, conversion, advertiser revenue, real browser visibility or real human clicks are measured.
Synthetic feedback never updates the existing FairJob/EB-NeRD production or research artifacts.
